subject: Request: Singapore exec workshop — last-minute fare & hotel night exception
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, TravelOps Agency <travelops@concur-agency.com>, Amy Li <amy@kitemedia.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Singapore exec workshop — last-minute fare & hotel night exception

Team,

Quick background: KiteMedia confirmed an in-person executive workshop in Singapore for June 2–4. We received the briefing yesterday and leadership (VP product + CRO) want to attend in person to finalize go-to-market commitments. TravelOps routed a standard itinerary but there are two items that need exception sign-off because of timing and cross-timezone necessity:

- Fare upgrade: the cheapest available fare leaves late on 5/31 (red-eye) and has multiple long connections. To ensure both VPs arrive fresh for the 6/2 morning session we need business-class outbound for 2 travelers. Incremental cost: SGD 4,200 (attached price_quote.xlsx).
- Additional hotel night: request an extra night (check-in 5/31) for the two VPs because arrival is late-night and hotel availability near the venue is limited. Incremental cost: SGD 580.

Total incremental ask: SGD 4,780 (~USD 3,500). This is a customer-facing executive engagement tied to a ~USD 1.2M ARR expansion opportunity (deal REDWOOD-ENT-4721). We need approvals to proceed with ticketing today to avoid price increases.

Action requested:
1) Vivek — please approve the fare upgrade + extra night (expense to be charged to REDWOOD-ENT-4721).
2) Laura — once Vivek signs off, please confirm GL code and procurement steps (we will need a PO or charge code). TravelOps, please hold pricing until we confirm.

I attached the itinerary and the agency quote. If we need alternative cost offsets (redeemable credits / upgrade voucher) please flag, but we should not risk losing the booking window.

Thanks,
Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AC/SDR Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Phone: +1-415-555-0187

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, TravelOps Agency <travelops@concur-agency.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Singapore exec workshop — last-minute fare & hotel night exception

Rachel — thanks for the clear breakdown and attachments. A couple of quick asks before I can process formally:

- Please confirm the charge code/PO to bill incremental costs to (or confirm that this is billable to the KiteMedia engagement).
- Attach a brief one-paragraph business justification for finance (I can paste into the approval ticket).

TravelOps: please hold both outbound fares and the 5/31 room night for 2 pax for 24 hours under the supplier quote ID (see price_quote.xlsx). If supplier needs immediate confirmation, ping me.

Happy to queue this through the expedited procurement flow once Vivek approves.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Travel & Ops Coordinator
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Singapore exec workshop — last-minute fare & hotel night exception

Thanks Rachel — I approve the business-class outbound for the two VPs and the additional night. This is an exec-level customer meeting tied to a strategic expansion; authorized charge to REDWOOD-ENT-4721.

Two notes:
- Rachel, please add a 1–2 line note in the approval form explaining why the upgrade is mission-critical (arrival readiness + customer-facing optics). Laura, please route through expedited procurement and include my sign-off.
- Marcus — can you confirm you don’t need to be on the same flight (if you are, we should book you economy and save costs).

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-05-29T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Singapore exec workshop — last-minute fare & hotel night exception

Thanks — I don't need to be on the same flight. I can take the late-night red-eye and arrive morning of 6/1 (I will be onsite but not in the 6/2 exec working group). Please proceed for the two VPs only.

Also, Finance asked whether we can absorb part of the cost using marketing event budget since the workshop includes GTM materials and an evening client dinner. If Laura/Finance confirm marketing can cover up to SGD 1,200, that would reduce Redwood's travel outlay.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, TravelOps Agency <travelops@concur-agency.com>

Date: 2026-05-30T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Singapore exec workshop — last-minute fare & hotel night exception

Vivek — thank you for the quick sign-off.

Laura — attached is the one-paragraph justification and the signed approval form (approval_form_signed.pdf). Summary paragraph to paste into the ticket:

"Executive presence is required for the final decision session with KiteMedia on 6/2; late connections risk fatigue and weaken negotiation effectiveness. Business-class outbound ensures peak readiness for two VPs and preserves Redwood's negotiation posture for a deal expected to exceed $1M ARR. Incremental costs are allocated to the KiteMedia engagement (REDWOOD-ENT-4721)."

TravelOps: please ticket business-class outbound for 2 pax and add the 5/31 room night; bill incremental charges to REDWOOD-ENT-4721 and route any remaining approvals through expedited procurement. Amy, please confirm the workshop agenda below still reflects a 9:00 AM start on 6/2.

Amy Li (KiteMedia): 
> Confirmed — agenda unchanged; 9:00 AM start on 6/2. We appreciate Redwood's flexibility and look forward to hosting.

Thanks all — Rachel
